message: <input type="text" name="q"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
disabled="false" still turns disabled on: a boolean attribute is on whenever it’s present. Remove the attribute to turn it off.
